Description: Performs Finesse Shots with slightly more curve and accuracy.
Performs Chip Shots faster and with slightly better accuracy.
Performs Power Shots faster and with slightly increased speed.
Set pieces are delivered with slightly increased speed, curve, and accuracy. Ball trajectory preview line is longer.
Performs headers with slightly increased power, accuracy and has access to unique Precision Header animations.
Performs volleys with slightly increased accuracy and has access to Acrobatic volley animations.
Performs Low Driven Shots with increased accuracy and quicker shot execution.
Performs Lofted and Fancy passes with improved accuracy and access to outside-of-the-foot passes and contextual Inventive passes.
Crosses travel faster and with more curve and accuracy.
Executes difficult first-time Ground Passes with slightly increased accuracy. Short distance Ground Passes are slightly more accurate.
Performs Lob and Lofted Through Passes with slightly increased accuracy and speed, making them more difficult to intercept.
Performs Ground Passes with increased speed and Driven Passes with improved accuracy.
Performs Through Passes with slightly increased accuracy, Swerve Passes with added curve, and Precision Passes that travel faster.
Increased max speed of Sprint Jockey and improved transition speed from jockey to sprint.
Increased reach when performing blocks and improved ability to make a successful block.
Increases the chances of standing tackle success and grants the ability to stop the ball directly at the player's feet when performing a tackle.
Grants the ability to stop the ball directly at their feet when performing a slide tackle.
Performs higher jumps and has improved defensive aerial presence.
Keeps close control of the ball while dribbling at jog speed and can shield the ball more effectively from stronger opponents.
Grants the ability to perform unique ground and flick Skill Moves.
Has reduced error when trapping the ball and is able to transition to dribbling faster with greater control.
Reaches a higher sprint speed while dribbling and has reduced chance of an error when sprinting or performing knock-ons.
Accelerates faster during Explosive Sprint.
Performs throw-ins with increased power to cover a greater distance.
Greater strength when performing physical tackles.
Greater strength when performing shield dribbles.
